exact.description: The quoted text, matched inside `node` only.

node.description: A paragraph id returned by `get_outline`, `read_blocks` or `search`.

occurrence.description: 1-based occurrence of `exact` among the matches that remain.

pos.description: Offsets for programs only; never computed by a model.

start.description: Start, UTF-8 bytes into the node's text.

anyOf.description: Which side of the target an insertion goes.

oneOf.description: Before the quote (or at the paragraph's start).
After the quote (or at the paragraph's end). The default.

side.description: For an insertion point: before or after the target.

Accept or reject tracked changes.
